title: melica littoralis
intro: Melica littoralis, commonly known as Sea Sweet Grass, is a perennial grass species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Melica littoralis include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal and anti-spasmodic, making it a useful remedy for gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
